from math import comb
from fractions import Fraction
from itertools import combinations

def b4(n):
    q, r = divmod(n, 4)
    return r*comb(q+1,2)+(4-r)*comb(q,2)
def f(d):
    return min(d*d//4,3*d//2)
caps={8:21,9:27,10:31,11:36,12:40,13:45,14:50,15:55,16:60,17:68}
low=[(l,18-l,84-7*l+b4(l),caps[18-l]) for l in range(5,11)]
rigid=[(l,17-l,76-7*l+b4(l+1),caps[17-l]) for l in range(8)]
assert all(a>b for l,m,a,b in low if l!=9)
assert low[4]==(9,9,27,27)
assert all(a>b for l,m,a,b in rigid if l<7)
assert rigid[-1]==(7,10,31,31)
assert all(f(d)+f(9-d)+Fraction(3,2)*d*(9-d)+6*d<=74 for d in range(1,9))
assert Fraction(740-3*comb(10,3),12)==Fraction(95,3)
assert (234-169)//6==10 and (215-170)//6==7
# Fixed K333 boundary only: no graph generation or candidate search.
parts=[set(range(0,3)),set(range(3,6)),set(range(6,9))]
valid=[]
for size in range(10):
    for tup in combinations(range(9),size):
        S=set(tup)
        if not all(S & part for part in parts):
            valid.append(S)
assert max(map(len,valid))==6
six=[S for S in valid if len(S)==6]
assert len(six)==3
for S in six:
    missing=set(range(9))-S
    assert any(missing==part for part in parts)
    assert any(a//3!=b//3 for a,b in combinations(S,2))
assert 64-2*6==52>3*6+6*5==48
assert 10-(9-1)==2<3
RESULT={'low_score_rows':low,'transversal_rows':rigid,
        'fixed_k333_subsets_checked':512,'max_attachment_size':6,
        'six_neighbor_types':len(six),'required_boundary_cross_edges':52,
        'boundary_cross_edge_cap':48,'status':'PASS'}
